body:
Adds `research/twin-recalibration` (digital twins theme, companion to `twin-upkeep`).

- Closed-form recalibration interval and experiment length for a twin refitted from dedicated experiments; downtime, estimation-noise and drift regret are equal at the optimum; excess scales as q_d^(1/3).
- Robustness (4x drift misjudgement costs at most 26%).
- Negative/limiting result: the second-order optimum destabilises 0.7-15% of cycles; a safe schedule costs 1.2-16x more and is 37-200x worse than an always-on Kalman twin.
- 10 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok; README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added.
